title: Published Reduction Percentages and Household Thresholds, Resort Lodging
content:
The revenue office publishes, for each Resort Lodging unit type, the reduction percentages taken off the room rate and the thresholds at which two of them start to apply, together with the number of units on one household account at which a reservation is handled as a group block.

The passholder reduction is the percentage taken off the room rate for a household shown on the collective's records as holding a season pass. The length-of-stay reduction is the percentage taken off when the stay reaches the unit type's length-of-stay threshold in nights. The advance booking reduction is the percentage taken off when the reservation is recorded at least the unit type's advance period in calendar days before arrival. The group block minimum is the number of units on one household account at which the reservation is handled as a group block instead.

| Unit type | Passholder reduction | Length-of-stay reduction | Length-of-stay threshold (nights) | Advance booking reduction | Advance period (calendar days) | Group block minimum (units) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 10 percent | 5 percent | 5 | 10 percent | 60 | 8 |
| Slopeside Studio | 10 percent | 7.5 percent | 5 | 10 percent | 60 | 6 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 12.5 percent | 10 percent | 7 | 12.5 percent | 90 | 5 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 12.5 percent | 10 percent | 7 | 12.5 percent | 90 | 5 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 15 percent | 10 percent | 7 | 15 percent | 90 | 4 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 15 percent | 12.5 percent | 7 | 15 percent | 120 | 3 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 0 percent | 15 percent | 10 | 20 percent | 150 | 2 |

### Points of judgement on the schedule

The passholder reduction and the advance booking reduction carry the same percentage for six of the seven unit types, but they are separate figures and part company at the top of the range, where the Private Mountain Chalet publishes no passholder reduction at all and the highest advance booking reduction of 20 percent. The length-of-stay reduction and its threshold move together only loosely: the Slopeside Studio reduces by 7.5 percent from 5 nights, while the Mountain Lodge Suite reduces by 10 percent but only from 7 nights. The group block minimum falls as the unit type grows, from 8 units for the Base Village Inn Room to 2 for the Private Mountain Chalet.
